references.text: The same procedure of isolation for seven days applies when the priest examines a skin disease and finds it is not deeper than the skin or unclear
A parallel situation where the priest examines a spot without white hair, which is not deeper than the skin and appears pale, and isolates the person for seven days
The continuation of the text describing what happens after the seven-day isolation period
A similar examination procedure and seven-day isolation for scabies in the hair or beard
A seven-day period is also mentioned in the cleansing ritual for leprosy
